tailoring.headline: E-Commerce Architect | SAP Commerce Cloud, Module Architecture & ERP/OMS/PIM Integrations
tailoring.summary: Backend and e-commerce developer with 5+ years of experience building, extending, and supporting large enterprise commerce platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell. Strong background in module architecture, custom extension development, and enterprise integrations connecting SAP Commerce with ERP, OMS, and PIM systems. Experienced in Java, Spring, OCC REST APIs, and data modeling, with proven success guiding cross-functional delivery between business stakeholders and international technical teams across complex environments.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Adobe Multi-Solution Architect, Adobe Commerce
cover_en.hook: Your opening calls for an architect with deep expertise across multi-solution commerce landscapes, enterprise integrations, and custom module architecture. With more than 5 years of professional experience engineering large-scale enterprise e-commerce platforms—specifically SAP Commerce Cloud—at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring proven architectural and hands-on integration competence to your team.

bullets.label: Module Architecture & Custom Extension Development
bullets.text: Designed and implemented backend and frontend functionality on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) using Java and Spring, customizing Interceptors, Populators, Converters, and platform extensions aligned with best practices.

bullets.label: ERP & OMS Integrations
bullets.text: Investigated and resolved integration bottlenecks between SAP ERP, MDM, and external commerce systems, while maintaining core Order Management (OMS) workflows and transaction processing.

bullets.label: PIM & Data Pipeline Architecture
bullets.text: Designed, built, and optimized PIM-to-commerce data pipelines using Profisee, Hotfolders, and DataHub to ensure synchronized catalog, pricing, and customer structures across global channels.

bullets.label: Headless APIs & Stakeholder Alignment
bullets.text: Developed and exposed OCC REST Web Services for headless consumers, engineered API migrations, and translated business requirements into technical solution designs with international stakeholders.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe with a valid German residence and work permit, I am currently serving my notice period until 15 December 2026 and am available to start on 16 December 2026. I welcome the opportunity to discuss how my enterprise commerce and integration experience will add value to your architecture practice.

tailoring.why_company: Your focus on multi-solution architecture and integrating complex platforms like SAP Commerce, ERP, OMS, and PIM aligns directly with my engineering background. Having spent 5+ years delivering robust e-commerce module architectures and enterprise integrations at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am excited to bring my integration expertise and techno-functional problem-solving to help guide multi-platform enterprise solutions.
tailoring.motivation_short: With 5+ years delivering SAP Commerce architectures, custom extension development, and multi-system integrations across ERP, OMS, and PIM at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep techno-functional expertise to multi-solution commerce ecosystems.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I saw your search for a Multi-Solution Commerce Architect. With 5+ years in SAP Commerce, module architecture, and ERP/OMS/PIM integrations at Rockwell and Shell, I would love to connect and share how my technical delivery background fits your team.
tailoring.email_subject: Application: Adobe Multi-Solution Architect, Adobe Commerce – Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the Adobe Multi-Solution Architect, Adobe Commerce position.

With over 5 years of experience delivering enterprise e-commerce platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring hands-on expertise in module architecture, custom extension development, and integrations across ERP, OMS, and PIM systems.

I am based in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German work permit, and am available to start on 16 December 2026.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
